notes: Patch is against HEAD. Desktop media:// uses the asynchronous reader; synchronous business readers and Web image delivery are unchanged.
Disk reads use fs.promises.readFile with request cancellation. Active reads/decode are bounded to 4, waiting closures to 256. Full queue returns 503.
Default capacity, queued/active cancellation, failure recovery, actual readForServeAsync pipeline and GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/error responses have targeted tests: 36 passed.
Tests verify byte/MIME parity and prohibit synchronous readFileSync in the asynchronous read API. Crypto derivation/decryption remains synchronous; no claim of complete main-thread isolation.
No measured Windows HDD latency, browser peak memory or total byte budget. Queue capacity limits requests, not the size of one asset. PERF07 remains partial.
